name: Facet
author: Facet authors
description: Live hardware readings in the bar, and a way into Facet, the hardware explorer.

barWidget.description: CPU temperature (or another reading) in the bar. Click for live hardware readings; right-click opens Facet.

schema.label: Show in the bar
schema.description: Which reading sits next to the icon. A sleeping discrete GPU is never woken to read it.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar value updates. The popup refreshes faster while it is open.
